WRITE AI Center.

A national research and development center exploring how generative AI can improve the teaching and learning of writing in postsecondary education.

Visit the WRITE AI Center →All projects

About the center

Building a stronger future for writing instruction.

Led by UC Irvine, the WRITE AI Center studies how generative AI can support effective, equitable writing instruction.

The center develops and evaluates AI-supported tools, works with faculty to design classroom practices, and studies implementation in gateway postsecondary writing courses. PapyrusAI provides the core platform for this research and development.

TimelineSeptember 2026 to August 2031
Support$10 million from the Institute of Education Sciences
FocusPostsecondary writing instruction

Center priorities

Research shaped by real classrooms.

Develop Useful Tools

The center advances PapyrusAI as a transparent, educator-guided environment for writing support.

Partner With Faculty

Faculty expertise helps shape tools and instructional approaches that respond to classroom needs.

Study Impact

Research examines teaching effectiveness, student learning, equity, and responsible implementation.
